title: Variadic functions not supports typed arrays
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.stable.mono.official [876b29033]

### System information

Windows 11

### Issue description

I'm starting to convert my test assertions to abstract and also using the new variadic argument type to improve the API.

I want to convert an existing function to use variadic arguments.
```gd
@abstract func extractv(
	extractor0 :GdUnitValueExtractor,
	extractor1 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null,
	extractor2 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null,
	extractor3 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null,
	extractor4 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null,
	extractor5 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null,
	extractor6 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null,
	extractor7 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null,
	extractor8 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null,
	extractor9 :GdUnitValueExtractor = null) -> GdUnitArrayAssert
```
to
```
@abstract func extractvs(...extractors: Array[GdUnitValueExtractor]) -> GdUnitArrayAssert
```
But it shows an compile error
`Typed arrays are currently not supported for the rest parameter.`


### Steps to reproduce

Try to write a variadic function with using typed array
e.g.
````
@abstract func extractvs(...nodes: Array[Node]) -> int
````

n/a
